title: Show PCI vendor and device codes
summary: Use lspci with the -nn flag to see both the human-readable names and the numeric vendor/device IDs for your hardware. This is useful when searching for drivers online.

steps.explain: Run lspci with the -nn flag to display vendor and device codes as both numbers and names.
steps.expect: A list of devices where each line includes names and numeric IDs in brackets, e.g., '[8086:1234]'
